title: Bangkok condo prices flatten in Q2
summary: Average asking prices in inner Bangkok moved less than 1% quarter on quarter.
body: After two years of steady growth, asking prices across inner Bangkok districts have effectively flattened. Agents report longer time-on-market for units above 15 million baht, while entry-level stock under 4 million continues to move quickly. Buyers with financing already approved are in the strongest position they have been in since 2023.

title: Zero agent fee on your first viewing
summary: Book any viewing through the app this month and we waive the booking fee.
body: For the month of August, HouseFinder is waiving the 500 baht viewing booking fee for all first-time users. Book directly from any property page and the fee is removed automatically at confirmation. Applies to one viewing per account.

title: New Pink Line stations open next month
summary: Four additional stations will open on the Pink Line extension in September.
body: The extension adds four stations serving Min Buri and Ram Inthra. Listings within one kilometre of the new stations have already seen a 6% increase in enquiry volume on our platform over the past 30 days.

title: 15% off legal fees with our partner firm
summary: Conveyancing discount for HouseFinder users completing before December.
body: We have partnered with a Bangkok conveyancing firm to offer 15% off standard legal fees for any purchase completed through a HouseFinder introduction before 31 December 2026. Quote the promo code when you engage them.

title: What the new mortgage rules mean for buyers
summary: LTV limits have changed for second properties. Here is the practical impact.
body: The revised loan-to-value framework tightens borrowing on second and subsequent properties while leaving first-home buyers largely unaffected. In practice, investors should expect to fund a larger deposit from cash. We walk through three worked examples.

title: Refer a friend, both get 1,000 baht
summary: Our referral programme is now live in the app.
body: Share your referral code from the Profile tab. When a friend books their first viewing, you both receive 1,000 baht credit toward booking fees. No limit on referrals.

title: Renting vs buying in 2026
summary: At current rates the break-even point has moved to roughly 6.5 years.
body: We modelled the total cost of renting against buying across five Bangkok districts. At today's mortgage rates and rental yields, buying overtakes renting at around six and a half years of occupancy, up from five years in 2024.
